scientific.integrity: The claim follows from the exact branch-averaged second-moment recursion of classic error feedback with an independent Bernoulli compressor. A complete cubic Jury test proves the full-state threshold, while an independent renewal argument recovers the same boundary and the communication-cycle optimum.
limitations: Only a deterministic scalar positive quadratic and iid Bernoulli transmissions are covered.
The learning rate is constant; diminishing-step convergence theory is not contradicted.
The no-memory comparison is a scalar diagnostic and is not a general recommendation against error feedback.
Multidimensional random sparsification, stochastic gradients, correlated communication, and modified residual schemes are outside scope.

title: Sharp mean-square stability loss for Bernoulli error-feedback sparsification
